items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: piano player named Charlie Fox... and Billy Hadnott, bass; Red Callender, bass.

ctx.x: piano player named Charlie Fox, out of St. Louis, was around here during that time, and Jimmy Bunn, the pianist; and Billy Hadnott, bass; Red Callender, bass.
Erroll Garner formed a trio later with Harold "Doc" West and Red Callender and him, and I was on some sets with them.
